OLD ROOTS. NEW WORLDS.

From roots
to the universe.

Tools for people who build their own worlds. Readable code, precise geometry and AI at the workbench.

A silent animated story: Thorns and Roots, a one-person software workshop. HEXAW makes WebAssembly readable. 3Draft is a tiny 3D engine with one material per face. Spider Paint is the first-person workshop. Through MCP, words become geometry. Five Percent, the VR entry: only 5% of the universe is known matter — a flight from the Sun to the Andromeda Galaxy through real star positions. Next: from atoms to galaxies with real data. spi3der: a 3D channel for every AI chat. From roots to the universe.

Fewer dependencies. More room to create.No build · TS + |> · WebAssembly

HOW IT FITS TOGETHER

One engine.
Many worlds.

3Draft is the engine. Spider Paint is the workshop built on it for the community. Five Percent is a frozen snapshot of Spider Paint, sent to a VR competition. spi3der is the long game: a 3D channel inside AI chats. And the same tools are heading in both directions — out to the edge of the universe and down to molecules and atoms.

THE ENGINE

3Draft

From a workbench
to the universe.

A compact 3D engine with a HEXAW-powered core, precise surface targeting and scenes stored as JSON. Materials lead the way — even interactive webpages and nested 3Draft scenes can become surfaces.

AI AT THE WORKBENCH

Give your agent
real tools.

From words to geometry.

3Draft and Spider Paint give compatible AI agents real modelling operations through MCP: build meshes, move objects, inspect surfaces, render scenes and steer the live viewer. No pretend screenshots — the result is editable geometry.

3Draft MCP tools ↗Real data for science & education →
PUBLIC MCP · NO SIGN-IN

Connect in one step.

Add Spider Paint as a custom connector in Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, with no authentication:

https://spider-paint.vercel.app/api/mcp

Then ask for a model, a sky scene from a real catalogue, or a guided flight to Andromeda. spi3der, our in-chat 3D workshop, has its own page.
